study.name: H11: 384px Pro HIGH — Image N=5
study.description:
Gemini 3.1 Pro, 5 image-track proposer passes with HIGH thinking at
T=0.7 on the full 384px evaluation area (611 tiles). Exploratory
analysis: the preregistration (§8.9) fixed thinking at MINIMAL, but
post-registration experiments found HIGH thinking improves consensus
voting at strict thresholds. Tests whether Pro with HIGH thinking
can outperform Flash consensus.
